verdict.rationale: Any product with public documentation could publish an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies to Working Copy. Direct probes found no such docs: llms.txt and markdown versions of the manual both returned 404. The in-app Repository Agent is a separate feature and does not provide agent-consumable documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
